Dear Sir/Madam, Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), we wish to inform you that the Company has received listing approvals from BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (“NSE”) vide their respective letters bearing reference numbers LOD/PREF/NJ/FIP/916/2026-27 dated October 9, 2026, and NSE/LIST/57422 dated October 9, 2026, respectively. The approvals have been granted for the listing of 1,00,00,000 (One Crore) equity shares of face value Re.1/- each, issued at a premium of Rs.1.80/- per share, bearing distinctive numbers from 221000001 to 231000000, allotted to non-promoters/public category on a preferential basis pursuant to the conversion of warrants. The copy of said listing approval is enclosed herewith for your reference and records. This is for your information and record.
